mapper.select: SELECT `value` AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS num FROM search_history WHERE `value` IS NOT NULL AND `value` != '' GROUP BY `value` ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sh.*, u.user_name FROM search_history sh LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON sh.user_id = sh.user_id
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{param.userName} ,'%')
and sh.user_id like concat('%', #{param.value} ,'%')
ORDER BY sh.create_time DESC
